biothings.name: chronic periodontitis
biothings.definition: A chronic inflammatory process that affects the tissues that surround and support the teeth. [NCIT:P378]

biothings.name: periapical periodontitis
biothings.definition: Inflammation of the periapical tissue. It includes general, unspecified, or acute nonsuppurative inflammation. Chronic nonsuppurative inflammation is periapical granuloma. Suppurative inflammation is periapical abscess. [MESH:D010485]

biothings.name: chronic apical periodontitis
biothings.synonyms: chronic periapical periodontitis, periapical periodontitis, chronic

opentargets.name: periodontitis
opentargets.description: An acute or chronic inflammatory process that affects the tissues that surround and support the teeth.

opentargets.name: periodontitis, aggressive 1
opentargets.description: A localized aggressive periodontitis, formerly called localized juvenile periodontitis. It is a destructive form of periodontitis characterized by ALVEOLAR BONE LOSS of the MOLARS and INCISORS. Inflammation and loss of PERIODONTIUM that is characterized by rapid attachment loss and bone destruction in the presence of little local factors such as DENTAL PLAQUE and DENTAL CALCULUS. This highly destructive form of periodontitis often occurs in young people and was called early-onset periodontitis, but this disease also appears in old people.

opentargets.name: chronic periodontitis
opentargets.description: A chronic inflammatory process that affects the tissues that surround and support the teeth.

opentargets.name: suppurative periapical periodontitis
opentargets.description: Localized collection of pus in the tissues that enclose the root of a tooth.
